text:
toby (BillingOps): Heads-up: 47 invoices routed to the wrong NetSuite subsidiary this morning; appears tied to region metadata.

ana (Finance): How many customers and any tax risk?

toby (BillingOps): 47 invoices across ~20 APAC customers. Tax code ended up as US_SALES instead of GST_APAC.

mei (Eng): quick root cause: we switched to use Stripe metadata `region` (lowercase) but our mapping table keys are TitleCase. Lookup failed -> defaulted to US_Main.

ns-bot: [ALERT] 47 invoices posted to subsidiary US_Main since 2024-06-12T00:10Z. See /alerts/4571.

mei (Eng): I can hotfix mapper to lowercase incoming region and fall back to `country`. Deploying patch to prod now.

cam (Support): Please hold customer-facing edits until we confirm fixes.

mei (Eng): Patch deployed. Plan: dry-run backfill using external_id upsert limited to subsidiary and tax_code. Command: `./backfill --ids /tmp/region_ids.txt --fields subsidiary,tax_code --dry-run`

ana (Finance): share a sample transformed payload from dry-run for audit.

mei (Eng): sample payload (dry-run):
```
{"external_id":"stripe_inv_3Xy","subsidiary":"APAC_Subsidiary","tax_code":"GST_APAC","metadata":{"region":"apac"}}
```

mei (Eng): dry-run reports 47 updates, no duplicates. Running full backfill in 15m with audit logging.

ns-bot: [BACKFILL] dry-run complete: 47 candidates.

ana (Finance): once backfill is done we'll validate GL snapshots and then OK external comms.

toby (BillingOps): Action items: mei run backfill, cam hold comms, ana validate post-backfill GLs.

mei (Eng): running full backfill now (2024-06-12T00:45Z). Will post results.

ns-bot: [BACKFILL] 47 invoices updated (no duplicates) at 2024-06-12T00:52Z. Audit log: /backfills/region_fix.log

ana (Finance): spot-checked GLs and tax codes. Looks good. You can send customer note.

cam (Support): outbound note drafted and queued.

toby (BillingOps): closing thread. Add alert for region-case mismatches to avoid silent defaulting next time.
